Afterglow browser edition

Authored application/bridge/adapters: AGPL-3.0-only. Full license: LICENSE.txt.
Source: https://github.com/sbrunwas/afterglow/tree/main/web

Circuit-informed drum models adapt GPL-3.0 Schwung 8W8 and 9W9 by athousanddetails.
808 rim derives from Sonic Pi; its MIT notice is retained below.
909 cymbal recordings are bundled from Matthew Cieplak / Extralife's GPL-3.0 ER-99.
Full GPL text: Schwung-GPL-LICENSE.txt. Pinned commits, source WAVs and notices are
retained in src/core/third_party. See ENGINE-NOTES.md for references and limits.

Legacy DaisySP / Mutable Instruments sources retain MIT notices in their directory
and DaisySP-LICENSE.txt; the new main engine uses the circuit adapters.

No JUCE or VST3 SDK runtime is included in the browser build.
Independent project, unaffiliated with Roland, Reason Studios or Ableton.
These are circuit-informed models, not independently hardware-validated exact
emulations. ER-99 audio is not claimed to be original Roland ROM dumps.
